status: Exploratory independent-scene ablation; implementation-audit amendment before inspecting test outcomes

interobserver.description: Same image + task, leave-one-participant-out normalized count density; reference, not a mathematical upper bound.

selected_before_test: D (provisional validation comparator, no arbitrary combined score)

protocol.sequence: B mask validity evaluated first on old exploratory scenes; C task guidance, D balanced selection, E adaptive proposals evaluated sequentially on six new validation scenes; F only after assessing C-E
protocol.independent_scenes: 12 additional mirror images selected by SHA256(phase4b-independent-v1:filename), six validation and six final test, disjoint from earlier 24
protocol.timing: All three timing models retained. Primary spatial ablation fixes the original fitted heuristic lognormal timing. No timing parameter fit in Phase4B.
protocol.design_parameters: peripheral width160/cap.35; revised task gain3, movement scale.20 diagonal; candidate groups normalized by area; no parameter sweeps on old test scenes
protocol.primary_units: scenes, simulation seeds averaged inside participant/task; paired scene bootstrap
protocol.limitations: Static TP categorical search, RT-conditioned windows, original source lacks exact event onsets; exploration mode has no human free-viewing validation here

protocol.selection_reason: D provisionally selected from initial validation for target acquisition/count NSS and simpler architecture, with worse timing mismatch explicitly retained. Corrected F/N are experimental ablations; no test-based model selection.
protocol.validation_note: Revision 2 is an implementation-audit amendment. Some test jobs started before the proto-attribute defect was found, but no held-out outcome scores were inspected before correction. A-E/S numerical paths unaffected; F/N validation and test supersede stale revision1 outputs.
protocol.audit_correction: Proto-only candidate attributes now computed from actual location/confidence instead of template. Found in source/trace audit, not from held-out outcome scores. Unchanged A-E/S retained; F/N revalidated and rescored. No held-out outcome scores inspected before correction.
protocol.metadata_audit: Evaluation now declares real photo bounds to A as metadata without enforcing them, so baseline padding probabilities and hatching are honest. A regenerated; its fixation coordinates/durations must match previous cached baseline exactly. No attention equations changed.

limits: Six independent-to-observer-development test scenes from released training material, not official held-out benchmark. Pretrained vision backbone may have seen COCO images.
Only correct target-present trials; no absent-target, free-viewing, dynamic-scene, head-eye or robot validation.
Model viewing windows and starts conditioned on humans; this does not predict response times. Human fixation durations clipped by cumulative RT because saccade gaps are unavailable.
Detector scores, internal confidence and proto support are uncalibrated. Annotated target-box overlap is only a target-specific recognition proxy, not mAP or calibrated semantic uncertainty.
No human memory test or complete object annotations: memory retention proxy does not validate human memory.
Approximate published 54 x 35 degree display geometry, not participant-specific calibration.
Pointwise crossed scene/participant bootstrap intervals; six scenes limit power. Sign-flip diagnostics assume scene exchangeability. Nonsignificance is not equivalence.

Revision2 fixes proto-candidate attribute inheritance discovered in trace audit; test jobs had started, but no outcome scores had been inspected. Unchanged A-E/S cache outputs retained; corrected F/N revalidated and rescored. Fresh-scene evidence remains exploratory.
